native_runtime_requirements.macOS: The pinned XGBoost wheel requires a compatible OpenMP runtime: brew install libomp. Match Python and Homebrew architecture.
native_runtime_requirements.Windows: The XGBoost wheel requires its Microsoft Visual C++ runtime; inspect the official installation guide if a DLL fails to load.
native_runtime_requirements.verification_scope: Windows integration checks do not certify macOS execution.

reproducibility_scope: Direct pins are not a complete platform-independent lock of Python, transitive dependencies, native libraries or CPU execution.
A current compatible environment can validate retained prediction tables and models without recreating every historical training environment.
Retraining follows the common analytical protocol; exact prediction or byte identity across platform/version changes is not asserted.
Preserve reference results and write reruns to new directories. Record current validation separately rather than editing original provenance.
Loading scikit-learn artifacts across versions is not supported as an exact persistence guarantee; inspect load warnings and verify predictions.
